subject.title: feat: add portable table presentation blocks

question: Should portable tables become a supported public plugin SDK presentation contract in this release?
rationale: This branch promotes tables from a Slack-specific rendering concern into a public cross-channel block type and three SDK exports that external plugins can depend on; correctness repairs cannot decide that long-term product and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve portable tables
options.body: Accept the public contract after both delivery defects are repaired and real channel proof is added.

options.title: Keep tables Slack-local
options.body: Remove the public SDK expansion and retain tables as a Slack-owned advanced rendering path.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers settle the broader portable presentation API roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve portable tables
recommendation.body: Accept the public contract after both delivery defects are repaired and real channel proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The sibling portable chart contract and recent Slack presentation behavior appear to be primarily owned through steipete's merged history.
